parameters.query:
select jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('token', cs.api_key)) as tokens,
       cs.id::text                as client_sequencer_id,
       cs.client_id::text         as client_id,
       cs.external_workspace_id   as workspace_id
from public.client_sequencers cs
join public.sequencers s on s.id = cs.sequencer_id and s.key = 'aimfox'
where cs.external_workspace_id = $1
  and cs.enabled
  and coalesce(cs.api_key, '') <> ''
limit 1;
